notes.title: Dreadline Express is riding for the DevGAMM Awards 2025!
notes.notes: [p]Dreadline Express has been accepted into the competition, which offers the chance to win a share of the $100,000 prize pool. More importantly, though, [b]it is an opportunity to gain visibility[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]For indie developers with limited resources, events like this are essential.[/p][p]As part of the competition, there is also a community award. You can play your part in this.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://devgamm.fillout.com/community-vote2025" style="button" buttoncolor="#d80833"]Don't be shy![/url][/p][p]Use the attached [url="https://devgamm.fillout.com/community-vote2025"]link[/url] and help a small developer with limited resources get noticed.[/p][p]The nominees will be announced on October 7. Fingers crossed! 🤞[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323292/466f0c5714f23ea5e9653f28238326cb5ababd9c.png"][/img][/p][p]- David[/p]

notes.title: Perfect blend of design, art, and gameplay
notes.notes: [p]Hey! My game won the Best Game award, and I've just realised that I forgot to mention it here![/p][p][/p][p]In June, my team and I showcased the game at the Game Access 2025 Conference in Brno. As part of the event, there was an awards ceremony, which we attended to see which of the [b]80+[/b] exhibited games would win the prize. When the moderator (and the general manager of Hangar 17) announced, "[b][i]The best game of Game Access 2025 is Dreadline Express[/i][/b]", I nearly failed to stand up![/p][p][/p][p]Please do enjoy these photos of our disbelieving, blissful faces:[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323292/7241ac9128e1d6b2d04bf074c0512930bbc16be7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323292/75b9c63b2bdd07e64fb91933f67a9f7fc8d5ff20.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323292/cb21bb3a06ff4a3562733e29244319f76d6f274d.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]I believe both players and professional judges appreciated the game's emphasis on player intelligence and cleverly constructed mysteries that encourage internal motivation. This creates a unique gaming experience that leaves a lasting impression.[/p][p]According to proposition, the award is given to a game that demonstrates [b]the perfect blend of design, art, and gameplay[/b]. Winning isn't just great motivation — it's a commitment to delivering something exceptional. Stay tuned for the journey ahead.[/p][p][/p][p]- David [/p][p](the guy with glasses in the photographs)[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Dreadline Express has reached four-digit wishlist territory!
notes.notes: [p][b]Over 1,000 souls currently await the arrival of the phantasmal train.[/b][/p][p]Not among them? There’s still time to board. The train can always use more human sacrifices.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323292/493d5a6d0608a60eadf3dca8efec5668442a669f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You cannot imagine how proud I am of what grew from my idea, and of all the attention the project attracts. I know it's a small number compared to other games, definitely not high enough to properly lubricate divine internet algorithms, but it's still an unimaginable amount of people to me. I thank every single one of you![/p][p][/p][p]- David[/p]

notes.title: Debut festival 2025!
notes.notes: [p]I'm happy to announce that Dreadline Express is part of the 2025 Debut Festival. After all, it is my debut.[/p][p][/p][p]Take a look at all of these awesome titles![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/gmdv/sale/DebutFestival2025" style="button"]Debut Festival 2025[/url][/p][p][/p][p]- David[/p]

notes.title: LIVE GAMEPLAY COMMENTARY at Gamer Pie Night
notes.notes: [p]Awesome news! I've been invited to give live commentary on Dreadline Express gameplay at [url="https://www.gamerpie.wtf/"]Gamer Pie Nights[/url] in Brno, Czech Republic.[/p][p][b]Expect insights about player-centric gamedesign and some juicy behind-the-scenes trivia you won't hear anywhere else.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]📅 Mark your calendar: August 28–30[/p][p]🗣️ Commentary in English.[/p][p]If you're in the area, don't miss out![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.gamerpie.wtf/" style="button"]Event website[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323292/cc57ef3b71f6e26deb616182fee601afb6d91f05.jpg"][/img][/p][p]- David[/p]

notes.title: 🚂 ALL ABOARD — UPDATED TRAILER ARRIVES!
notes.notes:
[p]The Dreadline Express has evolved significantly over the past six months. To give you a sneak peek, we updated the trailer. [b]Take a look at how great it looks![/b][/p][previewyoutube="-j0t6KyaRlU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]You may notice [b]improved graphics, new NPC characters, additional story elements, redesigned core systems, updated illustrations[/b], and more. However, the sum of all the changes greatly exceeds what you can see.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Farewell generative AI[/b][/h3][p]From day one, the AI-generated art was just a placeholder. And now? [b]It’s outta here.[/b][/p][p]Enter Krystof—our [url="https://kykyn.artstation.com/"]brilliant new illustrator[/url] who has been bringing to life all the bizarre and beautiful ideas I throw his way. The card art has leveled up: more creative, more unified, and delightfully surreal when it needs to be.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323292/64b0125ebfc3d4d70345855091ef33e5cdf84414.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It's finally time to remove the "AI Generated Content Disclosure" from the Steam page.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]More steam![/b][/h3][p]It's not only Krystof. The Dreadline Express team has practically doubled in size over the last six months. Rest assured, I will introduce you the other team members soon. Stay tuned![/p][p]In the meantime, please help us gain more steam! [b]Tell your friends, share the trailer, and spread the word—it will help us greatly![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, the conductor’s watching. Stay curious.[/p][p]
- David[/p][p]
[/p]
